get.description:
InterChange® API provides clean residential building data ready for use in building reconstruction calculations. This is the same clean data that is used by CoreLogic's industry leading RCT (Residential Component Technology®) Express solution.

The address (street, city, state, zip) is converted to a CoreLogic Integrated Property (CLIP) ID which is then used to gather pertinent building characteristic and component information.

Building characteristic data includes: living area, number of families, number of stories, year built and building style. In addition, confidence ranks for each field along with an overall confidence rank is provided.

Building components include: air conditioning, bathroom (full/half/quarter), basement finish, construction material, exterior wall material, fireplace type, foundation material, foundation type, garage type, heating type, interior wall material, pool type, roof material and roof shape.

get.summary: InterChange Property search by address, city, state, and zip code
get.description:
This API returns a list of properties that match the given search criteria.

To search for Properties by address, one of the following minimum search criteria must be specified:
  • {streetAddress, city, state}
  • {streetAddress, zipCode}
It is recommended that you provide as many attributes as possible to improve the accuracy of the results.

description.description: Indicates the air conditioning components and percentage of each associated with the property. Example: Heat/Central Air Conditioning, Percentage 100.

value.description: Represents the value, such as "100", of the air conditioning components unit of measure.

unitOfMeasure.description: The unit of measure, such as "percentage", that describes the composition of air conditioning components associated with each property.

value.description: Type of building style (e.g., Colonial, Cape Code, Bungalow).  See Building Style Code Modeled - Interchange for whether value was enriched via a model and Building Style Code Confidence Rank - Interchange for the confidence level of provided value.

modeled.description: Indicates whether the Building Style Code - Interchange value was modeled or not.  Values:  true = yes (modeled) or false = no (not modeled).

confidenceRank.description: A rank of 1-5 depicting the confidence level of the Building Style Code - InterChange value.  Rank descriptions: 5 = Very High; 4 = High; 3 = Moderate; 2 = Low level; 1 = Very Low. NULL if value is not Enriched.

streetAddress.description: CoreLogic standardized street address containing house number, street name, street direction, suffix/prefix, street suffix (e.g. 123 N Main St)

state.description: CoreLogic standardized two-letter state postal abbreviation (e.g. CA, TX)

zipPlus4.description: CoreLogic standardized last 4 digits of a USPS 9-digit zip code, which is used by the local mail carrier to identify the delivery route.

county.description: CoreLogic standardized county name associated with the property address

clip.description: CoreLogic Unique identification number assigned to each property.

houseNumber.description: CoreLogic standardized house number, usually the digits or letters found to the left of a street name in an address

streetNamePrefixDir.description: CoreLogic standardized field that represents the direction found to the left of the street name (e.g. 9340 N Dunhill Dr). Also know as Pre-Directional.

streetName.description: CoreLogic standardized name or number of the street where a parcel is located, this includes any prefixes that are considered to be part of the street name (e.g. Via De Luna, 34th).

streetNameSuffix.description: CoreLogic standardized mode or type of street found to the right of the street name such as Drive, avenue, parkway (e.g., 9340 N Dunhill Dr). Also known as Street Designators / Street modes

streetNameSuffixDir.description: CoreLogic standardized direction indicator that follows the listed property's street name and street mode. Examples: SW following the street number and name in the address, 505 Dean St. SW. Also known as Post Directional.

unitType.description: The unit type of the property adress ( e.g. Apartment, unit)

unitNumber.description: The unit or suite number of the property address (e.g., 649 Lake Shore Dr #1400).
